email.subject: Invoice #77104 - wrong amount
email.body:
Good afternoon,

We received invoice #77104 dated Nov 12 for the load we shipped Sudbury ON to London ON on Nov 5 (our PO NW-4471, 12 skids mining fittings).

The invoice shows $1,480.00 CAD line haul plus $225.00 detention at delivery. Our confirmed rate was $1,250.00 CAD all in, as per the rate confirmation your dispatcher sent when we booked. We also have no record of any detention being approved - the receiver's gate log shows the driver in at 10:05 and out at 11:20 on a 10:00 appointment.

Please send a corrected invoice for $1,250.00 CAD. We will hold payment on 77104 until then.

Regards,

Deborah Gauthier
Accounts Payable
Nickel Way Industrial Supply
705-555-0192 ext 3
